reran: cmd.sh on the integration build, the base and 2.13.18: type mismatch, found x1.type, required A1, as recorded; 2.12.20 the same. Scala 3.7.4 compiles it and prints Some(1). The example in scala/bug#8633 (open since 2014) still fails with the same message on the integration build.
user_impact: Every partial function literal inside a body that specialization duplicates is rejected: ys.collect { case x if x > 1 => p } or collectFirst in a method with a @specialized type parameter, or in a method of a specialized class whose signature mentions the parameter, with or without a guard (case 1 => p and case s: String => p fail too). Common in specialized code; users work around it by moving the literal out of the method.
fixability: clear cut in principle: the ticket links the fix made in the miniboxing plugin (commit 8529025c) which Vlad Ureche said ports directly; Duplicators must keep or correctly retype the synthesized applyOrElse. No compatibility cost.
links: H66 (retronym/scala#431) is another Duplicators retyping rejection. scala/bug#8694 was closed as a duplicate of #8633.
note: The finding says prior none found; it is scala/bug#8633 with the same message. The finding understates the trigger: a guard is not needed, and collect in a specialized method is enough.
